beats.narration_slice: The pages reveal Francesco Cirillo and the Pomodoro Technique.
beats.visual: A worn green book lies open on a rustic wooden desk, revealing an illustrated portrait of Francesco Cirillo beside a tomato-shaped timer drawing in a painted storybook style.
beats.purpose: show the discovery of Francesco Cirillo and the Pomodoro Technique through the book reveal
beats.visual_fingerprint: open worn green book with historical portrait and tomato timer illustration on farmhouse study desk, overhead close composition
beats.continuity: continues from the book retrieval with the same green book now opened indoors

beats.narration_slice: He studied with a tomato-shaped timer.
beats.visual: A late 20th-century study corner shows a young Francesco-inspired student figure working beside a small red tomato-shaped kitchen timer on a wooden desk, with notebooks and papers around him.
beats.purpose: show the original tomato-shaped timer influence in a study setting
beats.visual_fingerprint: young student silhouette at vintage desk using red tomato kitchen timer, warm interior side view composition
beats.continuity: moves from the book illustration into a historical study scene while preserving the timer focus

beats.narration_slice: The method breaks work into focused sessions.
beats.visual: A tidy wooden desk displays a single timer beside neatly grouped study materials, with three separated piles visually arranged in a rhythm from start to finish.
beats.purpose: show how the technique divides work into organized focus periods
beats.visual_fingerprint: organized study desk with three material clusters and timer centerpiece, top-down balanced composition
beats.continuity: same study world but shifts from historical person to a clear method explanation

beats.narration_slice: Short breaks help reset attention between sessions.
beats.visual: A cozy rural window nook shows a closed notebook, steaming tea cup, and timer resting during a peaceful pause with morning light entering.
beats.purpose: show the reset moment created by short breaks
beats.visual_fingerprint: quiet window nook with resting timer and tea beside closed notebook, soft morning pause composition
beats.continuity: continues the focused desk theme by showing the recovery space between sessions

beats.narration_slice: Distractions fade when goals receive protected time.
beats.visual: A farmhouse desk scene shows scattered papers being visually pushed to the edges while one central notebook and timer remain illuminated in the middle.
beats.purpose: show distractions losing importance when focus time is protected
beats.visual_fingerprint: central glowing notebook and timer surrounded by faded scattered papers, diagonal desk composition
beats.continuity: returns from the break scene to active work with a stronger focus metaphor

beats.narration_slice: The technique creates a steady rhythm for completing tasks.
beats.visual: A wooden shelf holds completed small projects, notebooks, and tools arranged in a repeating pattern beside a ticking timer, creating a visual sense of progress.
beats.purpose: show the steady rhythm and completion cycle created by the technique
beats.visual_fingerprint: rustic shelf with repeating completed tasks and timer, horizontal progression composition
beats.continuity: expands the focus idea from a single desk to a larger pattern of accomplishment

beats.narration_slice: A small timer signals when to start and stop.
beats.visual: Close view of a small pocket timer on a wooden table with one hand reaching to begin it and a notebook ready nearby.
beats.purpose: show the timer as the physical signal for beginning and ending work
beats.visual_fingerprint: pocket timer with reaching hand and prepared notebook, intimate close-up table composition
beats.continuity: returns attention to the key object after showing the broader rhythm

beats.narration_slice: The simple idea grew from one student's study habit.
beats.visual: A humble old study corner with handwritten notes, a small timer, and a single student's chair shows the origin of a personal routine.
beats.purpose: show the humble personal beginning of the idea
beats.visual_fingerprint: empty wooden student chair with notes and timer in vintage study corner, quiet wide composition
beats.continuity: shifts from the tool itself to the human habit behind its creation

beats.narration_slice: Today, people use it to structure focused work.
